spans.s:
प्रगंडः The upper part of the arm
from the elbow to the shoulder.
प्रगंडी The outer wall (of a city).

To advance, proceed.
--2 To set out.
--3 To reach, attain.

प्रगत p. p.
1 Gone forth or
forward.
--2 Separate, apart
--Comp.
--जानु, --जानुक a. bandy-legged,
bow-legged.

प्रगमः The first advance in
courtship, first manifestation of love.

1 Advance, progress.
--2
The first advance in courtship; see
प्रगम above.

To be bold or
confident; या कथंचन सखीवचनेन
प्रागभिप्रियतमं प्रजगल्भे Śi. 1. 18; न
मौक्तिकच्छिद्रकरी शलाका प्रगल्भते कर्मणि
टंकिकायाः

‘cannot be bold
(competent) enough to do the work
of a hatchet’.
--2 To be determined or
resolute.
--3 To be proud.
--4 To be
[]
ready or able (with inf.).

प्रगल्भ a.
1 Bold, confident.
--2
Daring, brave, intrepid, spirited,
courageous;

.
--3 Bold in
speech, eloquent; पुंवत्प्रगल्भा
प्रतिहाररक्षी

.
--4 Ready-witted,
prompt.
--5 Resolute, energetic.
--6
Mature (as age);

.
--9 Audacious, arrogant,
officious, proud.
--10 Shameless,
impudent;

.
--11 Illustrious,
eminent.
--ल्भा
1 A bold woman.
--2 A shrew, scolding woman.
--3 A
bold or mature woman, one of the
classes of heroines in poetic
composition; she is versed in all kinds of
caresses, lofty of demeanour,
possessed of no great modesty; of
mature age, and ruling her husband;
see S.

and examples quoted
ad loc.
--4 An epithet of Durgā.

1 Boldness.
--2
Resoluteness, energy.
--3 Pride,
arrogance.
--4 Eminence.
--5
Perverseness.

प्रगाथः p. p.
1 Dipped into,
soaked, steeped.
--2 Much, excessive,
intense.
--3 Firm, strong.
--4 Hard,
difficult.
--ढं
1 Privation.
--2
Penance, bodily mortification.
--ढं ind.
1 Very much, exceedingly.
--2
Firmly.
--3 Forcibly.
--4 Proportionately.

प्रगाढ A strophe, a combination
of two verses (ऋच्).

प्रगीत a.
1 Sung.
--2 Singing.
--3 Resonant with singing.
--तं
1
A song.
--2 A sing-song mode of
reciting.
प्रगीति f. A variety of metre.

प्रगुण a.
1 Straight, honest,
upright (lit. and fig.); बहिः
सर्वाकारप्रगुणरमणीयं व्यवहरन्

.
--2
Being in the right state or
condition, having excellent qualities;
श्रमजयात्प्रगुणां च करोत्यसौ तनुमतोऽनुमतः
सचिबैर्ययौ

. (b) Efficient; 9. 45.
--4 Skilful,
clever. (प्रगुणीकृ means
1 To make
straight, put in order, arrange.
--2
To make smooth.
--3 To nourish,
bring up).

प्रगुणित a.
1 Made even or straight.
--2 Made smooth.

प्रगे ind. Early in the morning,
at day-break; इत्थं रथाश्वेभानिषादिनां
प्रगे गणो नृपाणामथ तोरणाद्बहिः
Śi. 12. 1; सायं स्नायात्प्रगे तथा

;
4. 62.
--Comp.
--तन a. to be
performed in the morning.
--निश-शय a. who
is asleep at day-break.

To take, hold, seize,
grasp.
--2 To receive, accept.
--3
To curb, restrain.
--4 To stretch
forth, extend.
--5 To favour, behave
friendly with.
--6 To keep separate
(as the प्रगृह्य vowels).
--7 To offer.
--8 To unite with. --Caus. To
receive, accept.

प्रगृहीत p. p.
1 Held forth or out.
--2 Received, accepted.
--3 Not
subject to the rules of euphony (संधि);
see प्रगृह्य below.

1 A vowel which is not liable
to the rules of Saṃdhi or euphony
and which is allowed to be written
and pronounced separately;
ईदूदेद्द्बिवचनं प्रगृह्यं

(i. e. the
final ई, ऊ and ए of the dual
terminations of a word or any grammatical
form).
--2 Remembrance.
--3 A
sentence.

1 Holding or stretching
forth, holding out.
--2 Laying hold
of, taking, grasping, seizing.
--3
The commencement of an eclipse.
--4 (a) A rein, bridle; धृताः प्रग्रहाः
अवतरत्वायुष्मान् Ś. 1; Śi. 12. 31.
(b) A whip, lash, scourge.
--5 A
check, restraint.
--6 Binding,
confinement.
--7 A prisoner, captive.
--8
Taming, breaking (as an animal).
--9 A ray of light.
--10 The string
of a balance.
--11 A vowel not
subject to the rules of Saṃdhi or
euphony; see प्रगृह्य.
--12 N. of Viṣṇu.
--13 The arm.
--14 A leader, guide.
--15 Kindness, favour.
--16 The
Karṇikāra tree.

1 Seizing, taking.
--2
Bearing, carrying.
--3 The string of a
balance.
--4 A rein, bridle.

1 Taking, seizing, grasping.
[]
--2 The commencement of an eclipse.
--3 A rein, bridle.
--4 A check,
restraint.
--5 Binding, confining.
--6
Offering.
--7 Guiding.

प्रग्रीवः --वम्
1 A painted turret.
--2 A wooden fence round a
building.
--3 A window.
--4 A stable.
--5
The top of a tree.
--6 A
pleasurehouse.

प्रग्रीवः --वम्
1 A painted turret.
--2 A wooden fence round a
building.
--3 A window.
--4 A stable.
--5
The top of a tree.
--6 A
pleasurehouse.

1 Boldness, confidence;
निःसाध्वसत्वं प्रागल्भ्यं S. D.
--2 Pride,
arrogance.
--3 Proficiency, skill.
--4
Development, greatness, maturity;
बुद्धिप्रागल्भ्य, तमःप्रागल्भ्य &c.
--5
Manifestation, appearance; अवाप्तः
प्रागल्म्यं परिणतरुचः शैलतनये K.

‘which has appeared’.
--6
Eloquence, प्रागल्भ्यहीनस्य नरस्य विद्या
शस्त्रं यथा कापुरुषस्य हस्ते (where प्रा˚
may mean ‘boldness’ also);

प्राग्रं The highest point.
--Comp.
--सर a. first, fore most; त्वमर्हतां
[]
प्राग्रसरः स्मृतोऽसि नः Ś. 5. 15.
--हर a.
chief, principal; विश्वावसु प्राग्रहरैः
प्रवीणैः

प्राग्र्य a. Chief, foremost, best,
most excellent.
